contexts.text: God healed Abimelech () = the wholeness of doctrine as to good. To heal = to make whole... His wife also is said to be healed, by which is signified the wholeness of doctrine as to truth.
With these, doctrine thus... lives; and of them it is said, that they are healed, and bring forth.
Natural good... is to be restored to health by painful things.
That there may be a healthy mind in a healthy body.

With him who is in internals... the ruling affection is that the body may be nourished... for the sake of its health, to the end that there may be a healthy mind in a healthy body; thus principally for the sake of the health of the mind, to which the health of the body serves as a means. He who is a spiritual man does not rest here, but regards the health of the mind or soul as a means to imbue intelligence and wisdom...
As such truths are the means whereby man's Natural is perfected and also amended, therefore healing is ascribed to spices of this sort. Illustrated.
With those who are not being regenerated... the causes (of change of state) are... also reflections upon the health of the body...

But he who is being regenerated... loves the things of the body for the sake of the end that he may have a healthy mind in a healthy body; and he loves his mind and its health for the sake of an end still more interior...
To the end that the mind may enjoy its food when the body enjoys its; that is, that the man may have a healthy mind in a healthy body.
Nevertheless, this is no hindrance to man's being healed naturally; for the Divine Providence concurs with such means.
Not for the sake of the body, but... in order that the soul, in a healthy body, may act correspondently...
For evils and falsities take away health from the internal man...
They that are healthy need not a physician ()... By the healthy are meant the just.
The health of the daughter of My people () = the truth of doctrine there.
That healings... are not spoken of in the Word in a natural, but in a spiritual sense. Illustrated.

Everyone ought to consult for his body... This must be the first thing, but to the end that there may be a healthy mind in a healthy body... But he who consults for the body merely for the sake of the body, and does not think of the health of the mind... consults evilly for himself to eternity.

The delight of taste... has such delight because it serves for nourishment, and thence for the health of the body, according to which the mind acts healthily. The delight of smell is a less delight, because it serves only for recreation, and thus also for health.
All the miracles which the Lord did... signified that such as are signified... would receive the Gospel, and be spiritually healed; and this by the Advent of the Lord into the world.
See Feast.
I am Jehovah thy healer () = that the Lord alone preserves from evils. To heal = to remedy, and also to preserve from evils. Illustrated.
They added that useful food is to them savoury... It was said that this is well for man; for he thus has at heart to have a healthy mind in a healthy body...
(Thus) it is evident... why a number of healings were done by the Lord on the Sabbath days. Illustrated.
For the healing by looking at the serpent... signified healing from the evils of falsity by looking to faith in the Lord...
It is said, Lest I heal them () because they who are healed, and again return to falsities and evils, profane. AC 10498:end.
Hence healings were done by the Lord on the Sabbath day; for the healing involved the healing of the spiritual life...
To heal = to amend and restore.
When he lived in the world, he was sane in externals...
Lest they convert, and I heal them = lest they acknowledge truths and afterwards recede, and thus become profane.
When man is allowed to think the evils of his life's love even to intention, they are healed by spiritual means, as diseases are by natural means.
Meanwhile, he learns civil, moral, and spiritual things... and by means of them he is healed by the Lord; but no further than to know how to guard the door, unless he also acknowledges God...

The Lord could have healed the understanding with every man... and this by fears... But to heal the understanding alone, is to heal man only from without... and therefore the healing of the understanding only would be like a palliative healing... It is the will itself which must be healed... through instruction and exhortation by the understanding. If the understanding alone were healed, the man would become like an embalmed corpse...
In which there was an aura of wisdom, by which health returned to their minds.
With these, the bridle of (the love of the sex) is not relaxed any further than conduces to health.
Thus the health of both their mind and body would be ruined.
I was as it were obsessed by them, although I was as sane as at other times.

The Knowledge of (anatomy) contributes nothing to the preservation of health; so that he who understands nothing of these things, still lives as healthy... In like manner intellectual health may be possessed in a much greater degree by those who know nothing about the understanding...
In all other things they are apparently sane...
Aristotle is among the sane Spirits.
Healing in his wings () = the truth of faith.
The wings of Jehovah, in which there is healing = the truth from that good, which is the Divine Spiritual. Healing = reformation thereby.
Salvation by (His temptations) is signified by, By His wound healing is given to us ().

Deliverance from evils and falsities is signified by, I will make to ascend unto them health and cure; and I will heal them (); for to be spiritually healed is to be delivered from evils and falsities; and as this is done by the Lord through truths, it is said, I will reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.
That both Knowledges from the Word, and confirming scientifics, receive spiritual life through this Divine truth, is signified by the waters of the sea being thence healed ().
They who cannot be reformed, because they are in the falsities of evil, are signified by the miry places and marshes which are not healed, and go away into salt ().
For all the healings of diseases which were done by the Lord signified spiritual healings.
So shall Jehovah smite Egypt, in smiting and healing... and He shall be entreated of them and shall heal them () = temptations, and thus conversion, and healing from falsities by means of truths.
Its plague of death was healed () = the disagreement apparently removed by invented conjunctions of works with faith. Explained.
This would be like a palliative curing, by which the disease or ulcer is healed outwardly.
That a man is not of a healthy mind, unless use is his affection or occupation. General article.
Whether they would rather wish to think sanely or insanely... It has been found that they prefer to think insanely. Explained... In the world, they had never thought sanely with themselves...
But all who... have loved uses... think sanely in their spirit, and their spirit thinks sanely in their body...
They who are in heavenly love act sanely; but they who are in infernal love, insanely.

If this little work is not added to the former one, the Church cannot be healed. It would be only as a palliative cure; a wound in which the corrupted matter remains, and eats away the neighbouring parts. Orthodoxy is this corrupted matter, and the doctrine of the New Church does indeed furnish the remedy, but only outwardly.
